note: Pinned TTS sources for Phase-7 reception audio (P7 §27-37). Hashes are written by the reception-audio workflow's recon mode from a double-download that must agree byte-for-byte, then verified fail-closed on every later run. Model weights are NEVER committed to this repository — only these pins, the model cards, and the generated audio assets. The Piper engine itself is MIT (rhasspy/piper @ 73c04d81d5590ecc46e522de3601ce7fb29fc2be, VERSION 1.2.0).

licenseGate.note: Recon fails closed unless every voice's MODEL_CARD states a dataset/license matched by allow and matched by no deny entry (P7 §31, §37).

voices.role: speaker A — primary voice for announcements and monologue
speaker pool — dialogue second voices (pinned speaker ids chosen by canary ASR audit)

excludedVoices.reason: Upstream metadata associates its training dataset with AGPLv3 — excluded to avoid the licensing complication (P7 §31). Re-evaluate only with an explicit legal review.
